a.xlink:title: USBD_CtlContinueSendData continue sending data on the ctl pipe.
USBD_CtlReceiveStatus receive zero lzngth packet on the ctl pipe.
Sets a Stall condition on an endpoint of the Low Level Driver.
Returns the USB status depending on the HAL status:
USB_EPStartXfer setup and starts a transfer over an EP.
Copy a buffer from user memory area to packet memory area (PMA).
Set a STALL condition over an endpoint.
Prepare the EP0 to start the first control setup.
USB_EPSetStall set a stall condition over an EP.
